description: Source code for the lazy core intermediate representation (IR) in PyTorch, defining classes and functions related to IR nodes, outputs, and shape computations.

classes.name: Output
classes.description: Represents the output of a node in the IR, including methods for hashing and string conversion.

classes.name: Value
classes.description: Base class or component related to IR node values, providing hashing functions.

classes.name: OpKind
classes.description: Represents the operation kind in IR nodes, with methods for creation and hashing.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents an IR node with operation type, operands, shapes, and methods for shape computation and string representation.

methods.name: Output::hash
methods.description: Computes a hash for the output based on its node and index.

methods.name: Output::ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the output.

methods.name: Node::computeShape
methods.description: Computes the shape of a node, utilizing caching for efficiency.

methods.name: Node::addComputedShape
methods.description: Adds a computed shape to the node using a shape function.

methods.name: Node::ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the node, including shapes, operation, and metadata.
